statement: Cannabis cultivation, harvesting, trimming, and processing work can involve plant and biological exposures associated with allergic or irritant symptoms and work-related asthma risk.

review.rationale: Drafted from the reviewed NIOSH cannabis asthma/allergy bulletin and cross-checked against current NIOSH work-related asthma guidance on September 15, 2026. The claim describes an occupational risk association without diagnosing disease or asserting a specific incidence rate.
review.notes: Human scientific/occupational-health review is required before promotion.

sourceContext.contextTitle: Work-related respiratory patterns deserve early reporting
